title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B9.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C5.7 (Peaked November 09, 2026 at 04:10 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.7 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 07:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 737 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Sunny's hair would be a mess right now. 🌀🌎👀

Today’s solar images show a compact central sunspot group, bright active-region loops, and a broad darker coronal region, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
